title: Sessions now live in Postgres
summary: Sessions are stored in a Postgres `sessions` table with a 14-day expiry, so deploys no longer log anyone out and both replicas see the same logins. Everything in the plan is done except the sliding refresh, which we agreed to drop. **Please try the three checks below on staging** before I open the PR.
status: Implementation done and tests pass. Waiting for your checks.

items.title: Add SessionStore interface (no in-memory impl; use the test DB)
Route the auth middleware and login/logout through SessionStore
Dual-read the old in-memory sessions for 24h after deploy
items.note: Also copies a session to Postgres the first time it is read, so the old Map empties itself well before the 24 hours are up.
